hero.subtitle: Complete metadata, copy, and checklist for submitting Spellful to the App Store and Google Play.

categories.contentRating: Complete the Apple and Google age-rating questionnaires for community content and messaging.

descriptions.promotional: Discover your cosmic self with daily horoscopes, birth charts, tarot readings, moon rituals and astrology. Make magic your own with Spellful.
descriptions.short: Personalized horoscopes, 78-card tarot, moon rituals & grimoire journaling. Your witchcraft companion.
descriptions.full:
Discover your cosmic self. Awaken your intuition. Make magic your own.

Spellful is your personal sanctuary for astrology, tarot, moon magic, modern witchcraft and spiritual self-discovery.

DAILY HOROSCOPES & ASTROLOGY

Explore personalized daily horoscopes, zodiac insights and planetary movements. Discover what the cosmos reveals about your everyday life.

BIRTH CHART & SELF-DISCOVERY

Explore your astrological identity through your birth chart, sun sign, moon sign and rising sign. Discover deeper perspectives on your personality and spiritual journey.

TAROT & DIVINATION

Explore a complete 78-card tarot deck with five different spreads. Connect with your intuition through tarot readings and personal reflection.

MOON PHASES & RITUALS

Follow lunar cycles, discover upcoming moon phases and receive personalized ritual guidance aligned with your intentions.

COSMIC CALENDAR

Explore planetary movements, zodiac transitions and upcoming astrological events.

PERSONAL GRIMOIRE

Create your digital Book of Shadows. Save spells, rituals, herbs, crystals, dreams, tarot readings and journal entries.

FIND YOUR COVEN

Connect with like-minded spiritual seekers, share wisdom, explore magical interests and discover your community.

PERSONALIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE

Create your spiritual profile and build a sacred space that reflects your unique magical journey.

Whether you are curious about astrology, exploring manifestation or developing your witchcraft practice, Spellful brings your cosmic world together.

Your journey. Your universe. Your magic.

Cast. Create. Explore.

Astrology and divination are intended for personal reflection and entertainment.

Spellful is free to download. An optional, auto-renewing monthly Spellful Plus subscription unlocks additional features. The app shows the local price before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.
descriptions.whatsNew: Welcome to Spellful! This is our initial release. We've launched with the full 78-card tarot deck, personalized daily horoscopes, moon ritual planner, birth chart calculator, personal grimoire, and Spellful Academy. More features coming soon.
